inventory.visualPurpose: HMP shunt oxidative and nonoxidative phases
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 77 REACTIONS figure: oxidative (irreversible) band Glucose-6-Pi → (Glucose-6-P dehydrogenase, NADP+→NADPH) → 6-Phosphogluconate → (NADP+→NADPH, CO2) → Ribulose-5-Pi; Phosphopentose isomerase → Ribose-5-Pi → Nucleotide synthesis; nonoxidative (reversible) band with Transketolase B1 back to Fructose-6-Pi, Fructose 1,6-bisphosphate, DHAP, Glyceraldehyde-3-Pi.

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 77 glutathione cycle figure: G6PD (Glucose-6-P + NADP+ → 6-phosphogluconolactone + NADPH) feeding glutathione reductase (GSSG + NADPH → 2 GSH reduced + NADP+) feeding glutathione peroxidase (2 GSH + H2O2 → GSSG + 2H2O); Ribose-5-Pi → Nucleotide synthesis branch.

notes: Both p. 77 figures redrawn with full label fidelity: the REACTIONS map (two-phase bands, all metabolite nodes, G6PD/isomerase/transketolase enzyme labels, NADP+/NADPH/CO2 markers, nucleotide-synthesis branch, glycolysis reconnection) and the glutathione cycle (three enzyme boxes, GSH/GSSG/NADPH/NADP+/H2O2/2H2O/6-phosphogluconolactone labels, plus the deficiency panel).
